title: French Authorities Launch Dissolution Procedure Against Far-Right Association Égalité et Réconciliation
detail: French authorities initiated a dissolution procedure against Égalité et Réconciliation, the far-right association founded by Alain Soral, in a significant move against domestic extremist organizations.
